svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step two thick metal shapes stand on a flat oxide, and a thin pale film covers their tops, their sides and the floor between them. After it a thick violet resist layer with a flat top covers the whole slice, filling the space between the shapes; it has no opening here.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step two thick metal shapes stand on a flat oxide, and a thin pale film covers their tops, their sides and the floor between them. After it a thick violet resist layer with a flat top covers the whole slice, filling the space between the shapes; it has no opening here.
svg.text: Resist is coated, exposed through the nitride seal
reticle and developed; over the wiring it stays.
After: resist over the whole slice
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
